db:select.doc:name: Check Duplicate Incident
db:select.db:sql: SELECT incident_id FROM incidents WHERE customer_id = :customer_id AND title = :title AND status = 'OPEN' LIMIT 1

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "message": "Duplicate incident already exists", "existing_incident_id": payload[0].incident_id }

db:insert.doc:name: Insert Incident
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO incidents ( incident_id, customer_id, title, description, severity, category, contact_email, status, correlation_id, created_at ) VALUES ( :incident_id, :customer_id, :title, :description, :severity, :category, :contact_email, :status, :correlation_id, :created_at )
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ incident_id: vars.incidentId, customer_id: vars.originalPayload.customerId default vars.originalPayload.customer_id default null, title: vars.originalPayload.title, description: vars.originalPayload.description, severity: vars.originalPayload.severity, category: vars.originalPayload.category, contact_email: vars.originalPayload.contactEmail default vars.originalPayload.contact_email default null, status: "OPEN", correlation_id: vars.correlationId, created_at: now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"} }]

db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO audit_logs ( incident_id, correlation_id, api_name, action, status, error_message, retry_count, created_at ) VALUES ( :incident_id, :correlation_id, :api_name, :action, :status, :error_message, :retry_count, :created_at )

ee:transform.doc:name: Prepare Real Gemini Embedding for Storage
ee:transform.doc:description: Serializes the embedding_vector array to a JSON string using write(). After this transform payload.embedding_vector is a plain-text JSON string ready for LONGTEXT insertion.

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { incident_id: payload.incident_id, embedding_vector: write(payload.embedding_vector default [], "application/json"), model_used: "gemini-embedding-2" }

db:insert.doc:name: Insert Embedding into incident_embeddings
db:insert.doc:description: Inserts the serialized embedding string into the LONGTEXT column.
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO incident_embeddings ( incident_id, embedding_vector, model_used ) VALUES ( :incident_id, :embedding_vector, :model_used )
